output.reason: A 60-year-old man with sudden slurred speech and right facial droop resolving after about 10 minutes 45 minutes ago describes a likely TIA, which carries high early stroke risk and requires immediate emergency imaging and assessment even though symptoms have resolved.
output.patientMessage: Call 911 now. Sudden slurred speech with facial drooping, even though it cleared after about 10 minutes, can be a warning stroke that needs urgent hospital assessment today — the risk of a full stroke is highest in the next couple of days. Do not drive yourself and do not wait for a reply here. If symptoms return, tell the dispatcher immediately.
differential: Acute ischemic stroke with resolved symptoms
